activity.notes: Bolivia's 1851 Constitution expressly dates Manuel Isidoro Belzu's constitutional presidential term from 15 August 1850. He transferred power to his elected successor and son-in-law Jorge Córdova on 15 August 1855. ATLAS therefore distinguishes this constitutional presidency from Belzu's preceding de facto/provisional rule beginning in December 1848.

sources.title: Constitución Política de 1851 — Compendio Normativo de Leyes, Ministerio de Minería y Metalurgia de Bolivia
sources.citation_text: The constitutional transitional article states that Belzu's constitutional presidential term began on 15 August 1850.
